# A revision of a reading that opens a correction, along one process

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`a-revision-that-opens-a-correction` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F04 · [record](a-revision-that-opens-a-correction.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> A course of a process opens a correction where it leads to a configuration with a fitting uniform policy through the reading in force from one lacking it, acceptability fixed; on Revising's process, rebuilding the link from off opens it where a unit of stock remains after.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Correctable at a configuration: through the reading in force there, a uniform policy exists whose act at each reading is acceptable at every situation giving it and executable there; given choice over the readings, exactly where each reading has one such act. (`Becoming.OpenedCorrection.Correctable`, `Becoming.OpenedCorrection.correctable_iff`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
2. A course opens a correction from x to x' where a trace of the process leads from x to x', no fitting uniform policy exists at x and one exists at x', with one acceptability throughout; the gain may come from the reading, from executability, or both. (`Becoming.OpenedCorrection.OpensAlong`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
3. With readings in one type and a supplied map f between them: where f (reading x' s) = reading x s at every situation and every act executable at x stays executable at x', correctability is kept; where f (reading x s) = reading x' s at every situation and every act executable at x' was executable at x, nothing is opened. (`Becoming.OpenedCorrection.finer_keeps`, `Becoming.OpenedCorrection.coarser_opens_nothing`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
4. With every act counted acceptable, a configuration with an executable act is correctable already: an opening counts only with the acceptability fixed. (`Becoming.OpenedCorrection.widened_correctable`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
5. On Revising's stock-and-link process, the correction acceptable where it is needed and replenishing where it is not, executability the process's enabling: with the link off no configuration is correctable; with it on and a unit of stock every one is; with it on and no stock none is. (`Becoming.OpenedCorrection.Linked.acceptable`, `Becoming.OpenedCorrection.Linked.executable`, `Becoming.OpenedCorrection.Linked.unlinked_uncorrectable`, `Becoming.OpenedCorrection.Linked.linked_correctable`, `Becoming.OpenedCorrection.Linked.starved_uncorrectable`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
6. Starting with the link off and at least two units, rebuilding it opens the correction in one step; starting with it off and one unit, rebuilding alone does not, the rebuild consuming the last unit, though rebuilding then replenishing does; with every act counted acceptable, the unlinked configuration is correctable already. (`Becoming.OpenedCorrection.Linked.opens`, `Becoming.OpenedCorrection.Linked.rebuilt_starved`, `Becoming.OpenedCorrection.Linked.opens_after_replenishing`, `Becoming.OpenedCorrection.Linked.widened_unlinked`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
7. Replenishing alone opens the correction where the link is on and the stock is not: the reading unchanged, the gain is in what can be executed. (`Becoming.OpenedCorrection.Linked.opens_by_support`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- Any types of configurations, revision acts, situations, acts and readings; one type of readings in force at every configuration; acceptability on situations and acts, fixed; executability read at the configuration; choice over the readings only for the iff.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- What a formation chooses: uniform-policy existence is not a controller's act or run (Revising's controlled_revision states one).
- Double-loop learning in Argyris and Schön's sense, which turns on changing governing norms; here the acceptability is fixed.
- Which revision an institution can make or makes, or what a finer reading draws on beyond Revising's unit of stock.
- **Counterexample:** Rebuilding the link from one unit consumes the last unit, and the correction cannot be taken (OpenedCorrection.Linked.rebuilt_starved). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/OpenedCorrection.lean)
- **Counterexample:** With every act counted acceptable the unlinked configuration is correctable, so nothing is opened (OpenedCorrection.Linked.widened_unlinked). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/OpenedCorrection.lean)

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

AI reading: for an institution, the link is its rule of reading what its members report, by which line rather than how many, the stock what that reading draws on, and the correction the repair a report calls for. Revising an observation map is one formal mechanism that may take part in organizational learning; its relation to double-loop learning (Argyris and Schön 1978) depends on whether inquiry changes a governing norm or assumption, and here the acceptability is fixed and the law concerns uniform-policy existence along a course. Replacing a reading by one read off it through a supplied map, gaining no executability and with the acceptability fixed, opens no correction. With selection-under-registration-revision, where discrimination, support and enactment come apart, this states in policy form the correction they open. These are readings, not containments.
